name: Angus McGregor
bio:
Angus McGregor's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for racing simulators and a knack for troubleshooting computer systems. He turned his passion into a career, starting as a junior network administrator for a local racing team. His ability to optimize data flow during races quickly set him apart.

He prides himself on his proactive approach, anticipating potential IT issues before they impact performance. Angus believes that a robust and innovative IT infrastructure is crucial for gaining a competitive edge in modern motorsport. He is known for pushing the boundaries of existing systems and finding creative solutions to complex technical challenges. He is driven by the pursuit of efficiency and data-driven decision-making.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Angus is of average height with a lean build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Obsessively monitors server uptime on a smartwatch.
Has a collection of vintage computer components on his desk.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard for optimal tactile feedback.
